description: Find ToolCargo’s own ready-to-use hosted MCP connectors using catalogue text and curated task aliases. Every query word must match; exact task aliases come first. Returns exact endpoints, setup links, required credentials and shared-plan pricing. Use this first for supported hosted tools; discovery is free, running the chosen endpoint needs ToolCargo authentication.

limit.description: How many connectors to return (1-20). Keep it small: each result carries setup and pricing detail.

query.description: What the user wants to do, in their own words — for example 'read my google ads spend' or 'search console keywords'. Every word must match, so prefer two or three specific words over a sentence. Empty lists the whole hosted catalogue.

name: search_hosted_connectors
